Sole trader: no shares. Partnership: add partners. Private company: shares to chosen investors. Public company: shares to the public.
An asset offered to a lender who may take it if a loan is not repaid; it lowers the lender's risk and the interest charged.
The proportion of long-term finance that is borrowed; high gearing means fixed interest payments even in a poor year.
Interest = amount used × annual rate × months ÷ 12. Loans are charged for the whole term.
An overdraft is cheaper for a short need because interest is paid only while used; a loan can be cheaper for a long need.
